issues.description: The phrasing 'Internal attempts to resolve these workflow issues have been tried twice previously and failed' is slightly redundant and clunky.
issues.suggested_fix: Revise to 'Internal attempts to resolve these workflow issues have failed twice previously, underscoring the complexity of the challenge.'

issues.description: The proposal states that the final price will be determined once the budget cap is clarified, but it misses an opportunity to explicitly reassure the client that the scope will be tailored to fit whichever budget cap is ultimately approved.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a sentence stating: 'We are committed to tailoring the final scope of Phase 1 to fit within your finalized and approved budget constraints, ensuring maximum value delivery regardless of the final cap.'

risks: Severe internal misalignment among Northwind's leadership regarding budget, timeline, and core platform strategy poses a major risk. If these Open Questions are not definitively resolved prior to signing, the engagement is highly likely to stall, mirroring the fate of their previous internal attempts.

The tight dependency between the proposed workflow improvements and the strict November ELD compliance mandate means that any delays caused by the ongoing Q3 vs. Q4 timeline dispute could jeopardize regulatory compliance, risking severe penalties.
